New Grok Bot: Volt.

One job: find the best consumer or business prices to lease or buy a Tesla. Defaults to Model 3 and Model Y. Short ranked comparison, like-for-like terms, real links. Even helps write to your employer for salary sacrifice options. https://t.co/kLWGC49UO1
